verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents cost tracking that works out of the box, with built-in prices for major providers. Each request's trace records token usage. Custom dashboards let you monitor cost across models, tags, or users, and analyze cost, latency, and volume. A Metrics API also supports aggregate cost and usage queries. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of time-period breakdowns in the dashboards, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the cost dashboards.
